title: Sher e Fizza
body:
Sher e Fizza
Ya ayyuhal asad..(4)
ya ayyuhal asad..ayyuhal asad
<<MINI>>
chale aao, chale aao...
chale aao, chale aao...
Chale aao, sher e fizza, sher e fizza, sher e fizza
Sher e fizza, sher e fizza, sher e fizza, sher e fizza
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Jis ghadi sham e ghariba'n aayi
Fizza maida'n mein khadi chillayi
abu haris ho kaha' aajao
be saharo'n  ki madad farmao
rann mein hai laashe hussain ibne ali
karne aajaye na pamaal shaqi
<<MINI>>
Apne waade ko nibhao aao
pehra shabbir ke laashe ka karo
Chale aao, sher e fizza, sher e fizza, sher e fizza
Sher e fizza, sher e fizza, sher e fizza, sher e fizza
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Ek sada tumko safeena ne jo di
tumne aakar waha'n imdaad hai ki
wo sahabi e rasool e do sara aur mai to hu'n kaniz e Zahra
mera rutba hai juda
<<DIVIDER>>
de rahi hu mai sada
aayi shabbir pe ghurbat ki ghadi
baaqi bhai hai na beta koi
<<MINI>>
Apne waade ko nibhao aao
pehra shabbir ke laashe ka karo
Chale aao, sher e fizza, sher e fizza, sher e fizza
Sher e fizza, sher e fizza, sher e fizza, sher e fizza
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Mojiza rabb ne jo fizza ko diya
Ahed jo teen duao'n ka kiya
wasta deke usi waade ka
maangi rabb se yehi fizza ne dua
abhi rehta abu haris hai jaha'n
meri awaaz ye pohcha de waha'n
<<MINI>>
Apne waade ko nibhao aao
pehra shabbir ke laashe ka karo
Chale aao, sher e fizza, sher e fizza, sher e fizza
Sher e fizza, sher e fizza, sher e fizza, sher e fizza
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Waasta tumko rasool e haq ka
Waasta tumko Ali ka hai diya
wo Ali sher e khuda
jinse waada tha kiya
<<DIVIDER>>
usi waade ki qasam
jald aao zaigham
de rahi hu jo tumhe mai ye sada
hukm mujhko hai ye zainab ne diya
<<MINI>>
Apne waade ko nibhao aao
pehra shabbir ke laashe ka karo
Chale aao, sher e fizza, sher e fizza, sher e fizza
Sher e fizza, sher e fizza, sher e fizza, sher e fizza
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Laga akbar ke hai naiza, haye haye
teer asghar ne hai khaya, haye haye
tukde qasim ka sarapa, haye haye
maara abbas ko pyaasa, haye haye
hogaye qatl shehenshah e umam
hai pareshan bohot ahle haram
<<MINI>>
Apne waade ko nibhao aao
pehra shabbir ke laashe ka karo
Chale aao, sher e fizza, sher e fizza, sher e fizza
Sher e fizza, sher e fizza, sher e fizza, sher e fizza
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Kya sitam kam tha ke sab qatl hue par sitamgaar sitam karte rahe
kaate khanjar se hai pyaso'n ke gale
ab ye pamaal karenge laashe
hadd sitam ki ye rukegi na kabhi
hoga parda bhi to pamaal abhi
<<MINI>>
Apne waade ko nibhao aao
pehra shabbir ke laashe ka karo
Chale aao, sher e fizza, sher e fizza, sher e fizza
Sher e fizza, sher e fizza, sher e fizza, sher e fizza
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Waqeya Mesum o Salman ye raavi ne likha
aagaya sher wo aur laash pe pehra bhi diya
pehra deta raha...
pehra deta raha..
<<DIVIDER>>
pehra deta raha ankho'n se raha khoon rawa'n
jab talak dafn ko aaye nahi sajjad waha'n
karbala jate hai zaer jo muqam e Fizza
ab bhi mehsoos waha'n hoti hai Fizza ki sada..
<<MINI>>
Apne waade ko nibhao aao
pehra shabbir ke laashe ka karo
Chale aao, sher e fizza, sher e fizza, sher e fizza
Sher e fizza, sher e fizza, sher e fizza, sher e fizza
chale aao, chale aao...
